affected_boundaries: compatibility path for historical frozen checkpoints
causal_chain: The goal-declaration model is the only formal writer but sees deployment capability-effect identities and semantic guidance before freeze.
The writer is instructed to adopt a matching deployed identity, so installed capability vocabulary can shape the semantic candidate.
Independent validators can return alternative dependency/decomposition values that are fed into redeclaration, creating additional effective semantic authors.
FrozenSemanticContract faithfully freezes the resulting candidate, but the candidate may already have been capability-shaped.
Post-freeze exact matching then proves equality against capability-owned completion_effects/support_effects, so a nearby capability can influence meaning before exact enforcement begins.
Simply hiding the capability index without a capability-independent semantic vocabulary would make faithfully worded but differently named supported outputs fail to match.

A module-contributed semantic vocabulary independent of availability, frozen requested_outputs, violation-only validators, and exact output coverage restores the single-writer boundary without nearest-match authority.
rejected_hypotheses: The problem can be fixed only by adding courier-phone exclusion examples.
Raising a similarity threshold is sufficient.
Removing capability_effect_index from one prompt is safe without changing the post-freeze join.
FrozenSemanticContract alone guarantees single semantic authorship even when upstream validators prescribe replacement semantics.
A post-freeze LLM mapper from free-form effects to capabilities can remain execution-authoritative.
root_cause: The architecture has one frozen semantic store but not one semantic author. Deployment-owned capability identities leak into the pre-freeze writer, while independent validators can feed replacement semantic structures back to the writer. Because the post-freeze matcher is keyed to writer-produced capability-shaped effect identities, removing only the leak would create systematic false negatives. The missing boundary is a capability-independent semantic output contract plus exact post-freeze coverage compilation.
